items: Lead scientist for in-season crop yield forecasting with the ARYA model (NASA Harvest) in the USA, Spain, Italy, Ukraine, Russia, Kenya and Zimbabwe, with errors of around 15%.
Gradient-boosting yield models driven by multi-source satellite data (Sentinel-1/2, MODIS, PlanetScope) and agro-meteorological data (ERA5, ERA5-Land, AgERA5, CHIRPS, weather stations).
ADAPT-Africa (Gates Foundation): low-resolution crop type mapping and subnational yield modelling with ARYA to support food security.
Present results to ESA, FAO and national ministries.

roles.title: Scientist & Lead Developer - Global Crop Calendars (ESA-WorldCereal)

Field-scale wheat and barley yield models for Spain using Sentinel-1/2 and growing degree days, designed to transfer across sites and seasons.
Scientific lead for validation of field-scale products; PhD research on phenology-informed frameworks for yield monitoring and climate risk.
